remarks: Opportunity Knocks! Well maintained Brick 2 family home with a detached 2 car garage. Great opportunity to expand or build on this .38 lot across from Stamford Hospital. The Large drive way can accommodate 7 or 8 cars. Each unit has 2 bedrooms and one bath. Separate electric and gas meters. Unit 2 unit has the washer and dryer in the unit. Unit 1 has the washer in the unit and the dryer in the basement. The basement has two sides and room for storage. Both units have gas heat and hot water tanks that are one year old. There is also an attached shed. Please do your due diligence with the extra land before scheduling an appointment. 3 hour notice. Both tenants have been there a very long time and pay 1200 per month each.
